Poor experience.
Sep 2026 • Couples
Steep prices for mediocre to poor food. I had the seafood; they aim high here but fall short—the oysters au gratin tasted of cheap, fake cheddar, completely masking the flavor of the oysters themselves. The grilled garlic shrimp tasted of liquid butter; the flavor of fresh seafood was entirely absent.
Insider tip:
If you want to eat authentic food, find somewhere else.
